newsitem.title: USA: Plum Street receives FERC marketer certification.
newsitem.headline: Plum Street receives FERC marketer certification.

text.p: Plum Street Energy Marketing Inc said Thursday it has been granted certified power marketer status by the Federal Energy Regulatory Commission, pending the satisfaction of certain conditions.
Plum Street said it is reviewing these conditions to determine the best way to comply, and will respond to FERC within the required 15-day time period.
Plum Street Energy Marketing is a subsidiary of Plum Street Enterprises, which is owned by Opinac Energy Corp, a Canadian subsidiary of Niagara Mohawk Power Corp.

Power marketer certification will give Plum Street the flexibility to better serve current and prospective wholesale electricity customers by enabling it to actively buy and resell wholesale power at market-based prices from any supplier in the country, according to Marc Overdyk, Plum Street's director of bulk energy marketing.

The company said it now brokers power and natural gas to more than 70 wholesale customers in 13 states and two provinces of Canada, as well as to industrial, municipal and commercial customers in New York and New England.

While the company will initially focus much of its marketing in the Eastern United States and Canada, Plum Street's goals are to expand to "wherever customers need us," Overdyk said. -- New York Newsdesk 212-859-1610.
